tasks.subject: Humanities
tasks.commandTermDefinition: Break down in order to bring out the essential elements or structure.
tasks.title: Urban Transit Accessibility vs. Household Income
tasks.prompt: Analyze the relationship between median household income, transit access frequency, and car ownership rates across the four city zones. In your analysis, identify key correlations, note anomalies, and discuss the broader socio-economic implications.

stimulus.title: Public Transit Frequency vs. Household Socio-Economic Indicators (Metro Region)
stimulus.notes: Context: Zone C accommodates 46% of the city's essential shift-workers who commute into the Urban Core daily.

requiredVocab: The data clearly demonstrates an inverse correlation between...
A notable divergence occurs when contrasting Zone C and Zone D, where...
Consequently, the inadequate transit provision in Zone C disproportionately exacerbates structural inequality...
tasks.structureRule: Avoid 'I think' or personal opinions. Construct a 3-step analytical framework: 1. Identify primary correlations across variables; 2. Contrast anomalies (Zone C forced car dependence vs. Zone D affluent suburban choice); 3. Deduce structural socio-economic implications.

tasks.subject: Sciences
tasks.commandTermDefinition: Give valid reasons or evidence to support an answer or conclusion.
tasks.title: Selection of Groundwater Nitrate Remediation Technology
tasks.prompt: Justify the selection of Method B (Subsurface Permeable Bio-Barriers) over Method A and Method C as the optimal municipal intervention for agricultural runoff contamination, taking into account efficacy, environmental footprint, and municipal constraints.

stimulus.title: Performance and Resource Trial Data: Nitrate Remediation Technologies
stimulus.notes: Constraints: Municipal annual budget cap is $60,000. Land available adjacent to watershed is restricted to 2.0 hectares.

requiredVocab: Method B is conclusively the most viable remediation strategy because...
Although Method A achieves marginally higher removal efficiency, it is rendered unfeasible by...
Furthermore, Method C violates the spatial constraint of 2.0 hectares, requiring...
tasks.structureRule: Avoid 'I think' or personal opinions. Construct a 3-step validation framework: State clear selection of Method B, provide quantitative trade-off metrics (efficiency vs. cost/land caps), and systematically refute Method A (cost overrun) and Method C (spatial violation).
